bull.b: The Phase 2 retreatment data provide evidence of durable symptom control in generalized myasthenia gravis, including sustained improvements through 12 months. Favorable tolerability and the absence of serious or key CAR-T-associated toxicities support Descartes-08’s potential clinical differentiation.

Transient mRNA engineering offers a distinct therapeutic approach intended to deliver targeted cellular activity without permanent genetic modification. This platform characteristic may support a differentiated safety and development profile across autoimmune diseases and selected cancers.

Movement toward Phase 3 data and a planned biologics license application represents meaningful maturation of the lead program. Reaching these milestones could improve development visibility and create a clearer path toward potential commercialization if efficacy and safety remain supportive.

bear.b: As a pre-commercial clinical-stage biotechnology company, Cartesian lacks recurring product revenue to fund operations. Its ability to advance programs therefore depends on external financing or collaboration-related proceeds until a candidate can obtain approval and generate commercial sales.

The sharp revenue contraction and approximately $152 million TTM net loss indicate a highly unstable earnings profile. Deeply negative profitability reduces internal funding capacity, increases reliance on capital markets, and leaves future financial performance closely tied to clinical and regulatory execution.

bear.t: Persistent cash burn and strained equity
bear.b: Sustained operating and free-cash-flow deficits show that Cartesian continues to consume substantial cash while developing its pipeline. Combined with negative equity, this limits financial flexibility and increases the importance of securing additional funding to maintain clinical progress.
